MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 桌子 (zhuōzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. House
   C. Below
   D. Things

2. What does 上 (shàng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kitchen
   B. Bedroom
   C. Room
   D. On

3. Which sentence means "The fridge is in the kitchen."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在门旁边。
   B. 浴室在花园旁边。
   C. 冰箱在厨房。
   D. 床在卧室。

4. What does 星期天 (xīngqītiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Sunday
   C. Today
   D. Seven

5. How many strokes does 三 have? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 3

6. Which sentence means "On Saturday I rest at home."? (1 mark)
   A. 明天是星期四。
   B. 今天星期三。
   C. 我星期六在家休息。
   D. 星期天,去教堂。

7. In 我星期三去学校, what does 星期三 tell us? (1 mark)
   A. When
   B. What
   C. Where
   D. Who

8. Which Chinese word means "four"? (1 mark)
   A. 十 shí
   B. 四 sì
   C. 九 jiǔ
   D. 一 yī

9. What does 刀 (dāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. Knife
   C. To give (a gift)
   D. Month

10. Which sentence means "We sing."? (1 mark)
   A. 你生日是几月几号?
   B. 祝你生日快乐!
   C. 我们唱歌。
   D. 我们切蛋糕。

11. Which punctuation mark do we use between items in a list? (1 mark)
   A. 、
   B. !
   C. 。
   D. ?

12. Which word is pronounced yǐnliào? (1 mark)
   A. 饮料
   B. 饼
   C. 鸡肉
   D. 晚饭

13. What does 听 (tīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shoulder
   B. Two (before a counting word)
   C. To brush teeth
   D. To listen, to hear

14. Which word is pronounced xǐshǒu? (1 mark)
   A. 洗手
   B. 头
   C. 说
   D. 肩膀

15. What does 没有 méiyǒu mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is not
   B. Today
   C. Also
   D. Very

16. What does 云 (yún) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. Not
   C. Cloud
   D. It rains

17. What does 房子 (fángzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Bed
   C. Cat
   D. House

18. Which stroke is written first in 左? (1 mark)
   A. 竖 shù
   B. 点 diǎn
   C. 横 héng
   D. 撇 piě

19. What should you check on your display before a showcase? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only the colour
   C. Tone marks, stroke order, spelling and neat writing
   D. Only the size

20. What does 大家好 dàjiā hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello, everybody
   B. Happy birthday
   C. Thank you
   D. Goodbye

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write in characters the days Friday, Saturday and Sunday. (3 marks)

22. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Wednesday I go to school." (3 marks)

23. Rearrange and translate: 浴室 / 花园 / 旁边 / 在. (3 marks)

24. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: zhè shì xiāngjiāo. (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The rain is heavy." (2 marks)

26. Explain how a good presenter speaks and behaves during a showcase, giving five points. (5 marks)

27. Add punctuation to: 我喜欢芒果香蕉葡萄你呢 (3 marks)

28. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 上面, 周 and 同学们. (3 marks)

29. Write a plan for a model house: name four rooms or things in Chinese with pinyin and write one sentence about it. (4 marks)

30. Write the difference in meaning between chuáng and chuāng. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Table
   桌子 (zhuōzi) means table.

2. D — On
   上 (shàng) means on.

3. C — 冰箱在厨房。
   冰箱在厨房。 (bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.) means "The fridge is in the kitchen.".

4. B — Sunday
   星期天 (xīngqītiān) means Sunday.

5. D — 3
   三 is three horizontal lines.

6. C — 我星期六在家休息。
   我星期六在家休息。 (wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.) means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

7. A — When
   It is the time word.

8. B — 四 sì
   四 (sì) means four.

9. B — Knife
   刀 (dāo) means knife.

10. C — 我们唱歌。
   我们唱歌。 (wǒmen chànggē.) means "We sing.".

11. A — 、
   、 is the list comma.

12. A — 饮料
   饮料 is pronounced yǐnliào and means drinks.

13. D — To listen, to hear
   听 (tīng) means to listen, to hear.

14. A — 洗手
   洗手 is pronounced xǐshǒu and means to wash hands.

15. A — There is not
   没有 is the opposite of 有.

16. C — Cloud
   云 (yún) means cloud.

17. D — House
   房子 (fángzi) means house.

18. C — 横 héng
   左 begins with the horizontal stroke.

19. C — Tone marks, stroke order, spelling and neat writing
   Careful checking makes the display clear.

20. A — Hello, everybody
   大家 is everybody.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五, 星期六, 星期天.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 The bathroom is beside the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a banana.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 雨很大。 yǔ hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: Stands tall and smiles; looks at the audience; says each word clearly with the right tone; speaks at a steady pace and pauses; stays calm and repeats after a mistake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢芒果、香蕉、葡萄。你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 、, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for ?.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: 上面: shàngmiàn, above. 周: zhōu, week (short form). 同学们: tóngxuémen, classmates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 厨房 chúfáng, 客厅 kètīng, 卧室 wòshì, 床 chuáng. Sentence: 床在卧室。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name with pinyin, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: chuáng 床 is a bed and chuāng 窗 is a window. The tones are different.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.
